entries.description: A 40-acre farm owned and operated by one lesbian, offering camping space and welcoming visitors, non-lesbian women, children, and known men.
entries.raw_text: JAN F WALSH Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave, Shelby, MI 49455 (616)861-4939. I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a . 1 acre garden. I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) need to be decided in person. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males). I have/are: 1 lesbian, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Listed as 'JAN F WALSH Two Towers'; 'Two Towers' is the farm name and 'JAN F WALSH' is the owner/contact. Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned and lived on by one woman ('I own a farm, live on it... I have/are: 1 lesbian'). Men of any age are allowed if known or accompanied by women ('males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin', '(males)'), so Gay men and Non-gay men are coded. Farming/self-sufficiency coded for raising animals and a garden on her farm.

entries.description: An 80-acre cooperative farm with 4 year-round residents and 175 members, offering camping, chemical-free space, and welcoming new members, non-lesbian women, and children (boys up to age 2).
entries.raw_text: WISCONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful. Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 175 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative for a cooperative with 4 year-round residents and 175 members. Rural route address indicates land location. 4 year-round residents recorded ('Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer'). Environmentalism/eco-friendly coded for 'chemical free space'. Farming/self-sufficiency coded for farm with hayfield, orchard, garden, berries. Boy children restricted to 'til age of 2'.

entries.description: An 80-acre land lived on by two lesbians creating a chemically free, peaceful space focused on interdependent care and healing, open to primitive camping and welcoming children and differently abled women.
entries.raw_text: THE WEB c/o Lanning, Box 8742, Minneapolis, MN 55408 (612)983-2289. We are consciously creating a space in which to live our lesbian reality in harmony with the natural world. Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. We welcome: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/ electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', 'women living on the land'); though they hope to build a community, they do not list new members under 'We welcome:'. Land location not given beyond Minneapolis PO box. Disabled women coded for focus on interdependent care/healing and welcoming 'differently abled'. Environmentalism/eco-friendly coded for 'Chemically free'. Non-lesbian women coded for 'Primitive camping here is open to wimmin' (pre-1986).

entries.description: A 40-acre vacation ranch in Montana offering tipi lodgings, campsites, hot tub, and sports facilities for lesbians and gay men, with some womyn-only weeks.
entries.raw_text: NORTH CROW VACATION RANCH RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864 (406)676-5169. A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only. We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred. We welcome: girl and boy children, gay males. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space as it is a vacation ranch for visitors on holiday. Rural route address indicates land location. 2 residents based on '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Non-lesbian women coded for 'womyn only' weeks (pre-1986). Gay men explicitly welcomed.

entries.description: Four lesbians with 90 acres planning cabins, camping, and farming with an emphasis on solar technology and nurturing the female principle; welcoming new members.
entries.raw_text: REBECCA, SUSAN, ANNE & MAURINE 4026 Anderson SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108 (505)268-1863. The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs. Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle. We welcome: new members/resident. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 90 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: No community name given, so opening names used for community_name and contact_name. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative for 4 women organizing community land and welcoming new members. num_residents is 0 because cabins for personal use are in long-term plans and they live at an Albuquerque street address. Land state inferred as NM from Albuquerque address. Non-lesbian women coded from 'visiting women' (pre-1986). Environmentalism/eco-friendly coded for 'Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology'. Spirituality/ritual coded for 'nurtures the female principle'.

entries.description: A collective seeking two lesbian-feminists to reorganize and purchase 167 acres of land two hours north of San Francisco, committed to feminism and relationship and substance-free.
entries.raw_text: YORKVILLE WOMEN'S LAND COLLECTIVE c/o Annie, 50 Balmy, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)285-5145. YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group. Old group (save one) needs to sell. Lots of land 2 hours north of SF. Needs committment, money and respect. Into building living space, relationship, feminism. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Send name, address and phone for full details. Issues & money still negotiable. We welcome: new members, loans. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 167 acres, camping space, woods and meadows, farm land (grazing).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative. Land state inferred from '2 hours north of SF'. Land city left blank as town is not stated in text. num_residents left blank because the listing does not state that women live on the land yet ('Into building living space'). Recovery/substance-free coded for 'Not into drug abuse'.

entries.description: A privately owned 500-acre land near the Russian River open June through September for camping, events, and horse boarding, welcoming non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children under 10.
entries.raw_text: THE RANCH c/o Helen Wagner, 440 Holladay, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)824-5352. Privately Woman owned land open to camping and events June-Sept. Horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates and special event rates $5/day and up. We welcome: new members, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses. We have/are: 500 acres, housing/permanent structures limited to workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, farm land, cook out grills, creek on land, near Russian River, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('Privately Woman owned land'). Land state CA inferred from 'near Russian River'. num_residents left blank because no count of resident women is given. Boy children restricted to 'under 10'.

entries.description: A women's community and retreat on land near Elk with 8 resident lesbians, communal buildings, gardens, and orchard, seeking permanent members (especially lesbians over 50) and welcoming non-lesbian women and girl children.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, AC 95432. A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard. We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly). We have/are: 8 lesbians, 60 acres, 10 housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Contact state corrected from 'AC' to 'CA'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it calls itself 'community and retreat' ('community' named first) and has 8 resident lesbians living and working on the land seeking permanent members. Acreage recorded as 60 following the smaller number rule (text says 160 acres, 'We have/are' says 60 acres). Older women coded for 'began as an older womyn's community' and recruiting 'lesbians over 50'. Non-lesbian women coded for 'nonlesbian women (possibly)'.
